title.zh: 将卡林加省 Balbalan 市镇 Tabuk 国立中学 Buaya 附属校分离并改设为名为西卡林加国立中学的独立国立中学并拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Tabuk National High School, Buaya Annex, in the Municipality of Balbalan, Province of Kalinga From the Tabuk National High School in the Municipality of Tabuk, Province of Kalinga and Converting it into an Independent National High School to be known as the Western Kalinga National High School, and appropriating funds therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Buaya của Trường Trung học Tabuk Quốc gia tại Đô thị Balbalan, Tỉnh Kalinga khỏi Trường Trung học Tabuk Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Western Kalinga Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Buaya ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tabuk แห่งชาติในเทศบาล Balbalan จังหวัด Kalinga ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tabuk แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Western Kalinga แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Buaya, Sekolah Menengah Tabuk Nasional di Kotamadya Balbalan, Provinsi Kalinga dari Sekolah Menengah Tabuk Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Western Kalinga Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Buaya, Sekolah Menengah Tabuk Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Balbalan, Wilayah Kalinga daripada Sekolah Menengah Tabuk Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Western Kalinga Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Tabuk National High School, Buaya Annex in the Municipality of Balbalan, Province of Kalinga, is hereby separated from the Tabuk National High School in the Municipality of Tabuk and converted into a separate and independent national high school to be known as the Western Kalinga National High School.

The school shall offer secondary education proper, as well as secondary science courses to carry out its objectives and as may be authorized by the Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Tabuk National High School, Buaya Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Western Kalinga National High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Tabuk National High School, Buaya Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Western Kalinga National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
